success_criteria.definition_of_10x_improvement: Not a marketing claim. Measured as 10x fewer false-positive server picks that lead to rapid reconnects, plus sub-millisecond selection latency, plus fewer reconnect loops by preferring stability (loss/jitter) over noisy bandwidth spikes.
success_criteria.non_blocking: ML/optimizer must suggest only; it must never hard-block VPN connectivity. Callers must always fall back to a known-good server when suggestions are invalid.
